name: Broken-Arrow-Mod-Realism-Overhaul
description: Realism overhaul for Broken Arrow (MelonLoader): real speeds, engine power, armour and weapons, Logistics Front on 22 enlarged maps, smarter AI commander, co-op and PvP through the mod's own Steam lobbies. EN FR RU DE ZH.

paragraphs: The campaign, the scenarios and the skirmish, fought the way the equipment was actually built to fight.

Broken Arrow gives you real vehicles, real weapons and real doctrine, and then lets a 152 mm howitzer drop a shell on the tank parked next to it, lets a machine gun swat an aircraft three kilometres up, and caps every missile at the 9 km edge of its old maps.

This mod rewrites more than 12,000 values with real-world data and rebuilds the game around them: real armour, engines, rates of fire, loadouts and published ranges up to 100 km, every price set on real combat value, and an enemy commander who only knows what his own units see. You fight as a nation, one of twelve countries in two camps, NATO and CSTO, with the equipment it really fields, and you choose your realism: Realistic or Semi-realistic.
features: You will pick your fights in the air, because a Su-35 or a Su-57 out-turns every Western fighter, and an F-35 has the edge only when it fires first, from far away.
You will aim for the optics, because a hit that does not penetrate can still blind a tank, knock its sights off or break its tracks.
You will escort your transports, because when a carrier is destroyed, the squads inside rarely get out.
You will stop using artillery as a panic button, because guns have minimum ranges, real aiming times and a real emplacement after every move.
You will fear the ground when you fly, because two anti-air missile hits bring down anything that flies, and flying low hands you to every machine gun in reach.

whatItDoes.text: The campaign, the scenarios and the skirmish, fought the way the equipment was actually built to fight.
